resources.string: Khmer Unicode Layout for External Keyboard

This keyboard offers Khmer (NiDA), English (US), French (FR) and Chinese (ZH).
Press Ctrl+Space to move to the next enabled language, Ctrl+Shift+Space to go back. Choose which languages take part below — tick just one if you never want the shortcut to change language.
Each language keeps its own physical keyboard layout. Set them under Physical keyboard: Khmer Unicode for Khmer, English (US) for English, French for French.
Note: Chinese types Latin letters only. This keyboard has no pinyin conversion, so it cannot produce Chinese characters — use Gboard or another Chinese input method for that.
Show the on-screen keyboard even when a physical keyboard is connected
